# sh-data-card

**Purpose:** card that presents one data summary. Type Score = title, text, link and a score ring; Promo = title, text, CTA (Action slot) and pictogram / image (Visual slot); Usage = title, value, progress bar and note.

**Keywords:** data card, score, match, promo, banner, usage, quota, progress, summary card, stat

Core · 3 variants · [Open in Figma](https://www.figma.com/design/l1SuD1Q1l8QXGvtomszGYW/Shaadi-DNA?node-id=2644-46398) (node `2644:46398`)

*Generated by `tools/components.py` from Figma. Values are token names; never copy numbers.*

## Types

### Type=Score

**Purpose:** score ring on the right (astro / compatibility match).

### Type=Promo

**Purpose:** promotional card — title, supporting text, a CTA in Action slot and a pictogram or image in Visual slot (Get a Gold Badge, Premium Assist, Safety centre).

### Type=Usage

**Purpose:** quota or usage summary — title, value ("10 of 72 used"), progress bar and a note (Contacts Viewed, add-on usage).
